<!-- pr-reviewer: 8aaf75466b103ff802eb9af61f9f557490ae6df2 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one clippy error; everything else is green).

**What looks good**
- `MoveModel` carries the single-part stock, or the stock whose `FromModel` source is that part, in the same command. Undo restores both. `check_location` is applied to the new stock pose when the command is created, so a bad pose never enters history (`commands/move_model.rs`).
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in non-test code. The only new `as` cast is in a test. `canon_ring` and `minimum_rotation` (`stitch.rs`) are linear and are checked against the old brute-force version for every ring up to length 7.
- Rotated Face picks are refused early at the door (`picks.rs`). `selection.rs` no longer projects the whole solid for a closed face boundary.
- Redraw logic is split into a testable `redraw_delay`, with tests. Idle documents now wait instead of polling.
- `CAMCRAFT_PROFILE_PROJECTION` is read once into a `OnceLock`. When it is off, the cost is one `Instant::now()` per cache miss and no printing.
- File sizes: `stitch.rs` is 398 lines, `move_model.rs` 131.

**Local results** (merged with main at 8aaf754; run in `crates/ui` where the UI suite needs it)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| geometry `--test slice` | 10 passed |
| app `--test commands_undo` | 32 passed |
| app `--test pick_doors` | 6 passed |
| app `--test stock_play` | 7 passed |
| app lib `canonical_ring` | 1 passed |
| ui `--lib` | 240 passed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | **FAILED** in geometry; app and ui were not reached |

```
error: unused `std::result::Result` in tuple element 2 that must be used
   --> crates\geometry\src\geometry\slice.rs:240:13
    |
240 |             cache.remove(0);
```

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/geometry/src/geometry/slice.rs:240`: `cache.remove(0);` drops a tuple containing a `Result`, which trips `unused_must_use` under `-D warnings`. Write `let _evicted = cache.remove(0);`, or use `cache.drain(..1);`. Then re-run clippy on all three crates, because app and ui were blocked behind this error.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The projection cache clones the full facet list (up to 50k triangles) on every miss, and hits compare the full slice. This is cheap next to the 16-slice union it saves, but it is worth keeping in mind.
- `shell.rs` is 1559 lines and grew by about 190, and `state.rs` is 3538 lines. Both were already over the 400-line limit. If you touch the window-event handling again, a split into a redraw/resize module would help.
- The PR is a draft, and the body says "Refs #164", so the issue won't close on merge. Is that intended? The body also has no `Changelog:` line, so please add one (or `none`).
- The `RECOMMENDED.md` merge kept both sides.
- No snapshot or golden files changed. No build.rs, scripts, `.github/` or dependency changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
